sourceBinding: Working owned files only; source copy hashes below bind the actual package tested. Not a committed phase candidate.
scope: P02-T02 protected assembly verification slice; no full lifecycle completion.
environment: Native WSL Linux filesystem source copy, linux/amd64
coverage: Four fixed distinct roles, stable output ordering and copied member values.
Separate trusted raw assembly digest refuses altered JSON and jointly changed binary declarations; expected release authority/version/parent digest/API checked.
Actual file tampering, missing member file, directory entrypoint, missing root and empty root refused.
Real within/outside file and parent-directory symlinks, traversal, absolute/drive/backslash/NUL and overlong paths refused.
Closed required shapes, duplicate literal/escaped keys, invalid UTF8/lone surrogate/trailing JSON refused.
P01 safe-integer semantics include accepted integer-valued decimals/exponents and reject fractional/unsafe/bool/string revisions.
Literal and escaped valid Unicode entrypoints verified.
API: assembly.Verify(raw []byte, packageDir string, trust Trust) (Verified,error); value-copy PackageRoot/Release/Members getters. Authority/Trust/Member exported; no process or broker API.
pins: Initial platform go.mod uses approved github.com/controlLogix/agentmux/platform module; Go1.27.2/nats.go1.54.0 and exact transitive pins/go.sum retained from accepted spike. Assembly uses standard library only.
requiredFollowup: Root register five owned paths and specific component checks; update affected pattern review through actual source inspection.

Supervisor must prevent verified package writes and bind execution to checked objects; path verification followed by later path-based exec still races. Executable mode/format/interpreter policy remains supervisor work.
Trusted release authority enrollment/signature/key policy, process lifecycle, readiness, kernel accounts, Compose and supported native-host qualification remain separate P02/later work.
limits: Hashing and os.Root containment protect verification reads; file contents may change during or after hashing without release write protection. Files are closed before returning paths.
Host-selected root is canonicalized; entrypoint symlinks inside it are refused. This does not turn a writable release directory into a sandbox.
Caller must supply authenticated Trust separately; checksums do not enroll or authenticate a release authority.
No protected member process spawned, no broker/Docker/user config/legacy code changed.
Only isolated package tests ran; no broad runtime qualification claimed.
